notes:
QuickBooks Online (QBO) is a cloud-based accounting platform for small and medium-sized businesses, offering features for invoicing, expense tracking, payroll, and financial reporting.

### API Authentication
QuickBooks Online uses **OAuth 2.0** as its primary authentication method for the public API. A multi-tenant integration platform would use the standard OAuth 2.0 flow to allow users to authorize access to their specific company data.
*   **Evidence:** "You'll need to authenticate using OAuth 2.0, handle user permissions, and ensure your app follows Intuit's API guidelines." ([Source 1.5.3](https://satvasolutions.com/quickbooks-online-api-limitations/))
*   **Evidence:** "The QuickBooks Online Accounting API (v3) gives developers REST access... The API uses OAuth 2.0 with the Intuit OAuth platform." ([Source 1.4.4](https://github.com/api-evangelist/quickbooks/blob/main/README.md))

### Developer Access & Cost
**Access Category:** `approval_required`
Developers can sign up for a free account and get immediate access to a sandbox environment. However, obtaining production credentials requires completing a mandatory assessment process. As of July 2025, Intuit introduced a tiered "App Partner Program" that charges for data retrieval (reads).
*   **Credential Acquisition:** "If you have a new or development-mode app, you will not be able to access your production credentials until your questionnaire is submitted and your app is approved." ([Source 1.5.1](https://help.developer.intuit.com/s/article/App-Assessment-Questionnaire-FAQ))
*   **Cost (Free Tier):** "Builder is free... 500,000 reads, then blocked. No listing." ([Source 1.1.2](https://maesn.com/blog/quickbooks-api-pricing-2026/))
*   **Cost (Paid Plans):** "Four tiers: Builder, Silver, Gold and Platinum. Free, 300, 1.700 and 4.500 USD a month, each with a larger allowance of metered calls." ([Source 1.1.2](https://maesn.com/blog/quickbooks-api-pricing-2026/))
*   **API Classification:** "Core API calls cover most data-in operations... unmetered and uncharged. CorePlus API calls cover most data-out operations... metered and charges may apply." ([Source 1.1.4](https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/learn/app-partner-program))

### API Details
*   **Style:** REST (v3). "REST API (v3) for managing customers, invoices, estimates, payments..." ([Source 1.4.4](https://github.com/api-evangelist/quickbooks/blob/main/README.md))
*   **Breadth:** Extremely broad, covering 29+ entity types including Invoices, Customers, Payments, Bills, Vendors, and 11+ financial reports. ([Source 1.2.2](https://usecarly.com/mcp/quickbooks/))
*   **OpenAPI Spec:** Officially not supported, though community versions exist. "Our APIs are custom and are not Open API/Swagger compliant." ([Source 1.4.2](https://help.developer.intuit.com/s/article/Open-API-docs-Swagger-docs-for-QuickBooks-Online-API-and-Payments-API))
*   **Webhooks:** Supported. "Webhooks. Supported. Webhooks management API. Yes." ([Source 1.4.5](https://apitracker.io/a/quickbooks))
*   **Sandbox:** Available for free upon account creation. "When you create an intuit developer account, we create a quickbooks test company called a sandbox company." ([Source](https://intuit-developer-faq.readthedocs.io/en/latest/getting_started/))

### MCP Servers
*   **Official:** Yes. Intuit maintains an official open-source MCP server. "Intuit also publishes quickbooks-online-mcp-server under its own GitHub organization... It exposes the QuickBooks Online API in depth, 144 tools across 29 entity types plus 11 financial reports." ([Source 1.2.2](https://usecarly.com/mcp/quickbooks/))
*   **Community:** Several community servers exist, including those from Wyre and DataGrout.ai. ([Source 1.2.1](https://kipper.com/mcp/quickbooks/))

### Buildability Verdict
**Verdict:** `ready_with_friction`
**Main Blocker:** The mandatory **App Assessment Questionnaire** and potential security review required for production credentials, combined with the **tiered pricing model** that meters read operations, create significant friction for scaling multi-tenant integrations.

*   **Note:** While a developer can build and test immediately in the sandbox (`ready_now` for dev), the transition to production is gated by a review process that can take "2 weeks to 2 months." ([Source 1.5.3](https://satvasolutions.com/quickbooks-online-api-limitations/))
